about: Per-service sentence patterns for the facility x service knowledge base. A sentence matches a service when 'include' hits and 'exclude' does not (after 'strip_before_match' is removed, icu only). Shared non-offer cues remove a match from positive evidence; weakening cues keep it but mark it qualified. 'quantity' extracts counts or sizes (beds, machines, tesla, slices). Patterns of the 8 cleaning/claims services are copied from cleaning/claims/lexicon.py unchanged; the others are new (lexicon_src.py comments give each exclusion's reason).
regex_flavor: Python re, case-insensitive, one sentence at a time; uses \b and (?!...) lookahead (Java/Spark ok, RE2/DuckDB not).
